newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 10.5 trln rbls of paper on Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 10.5 trln rbls of paper on Nov 6.

text.p: The Russian finance ministry will auction eight trillion roubles in six-month GKO Treasury bills and 2.50 trillion roubles in a new tranche of OFZ discount bonds on November 6, the central bank said on Wednesday.
Full details of the auctions follow:
* Russia to auction 10.5 trln rbls of paper on Nov 6 nMY3002492
Full details of the T-bill auction:
NOTE - Although the issue runs for over seven months, it is officially classified as six-month paper.
Full details of the bond issue:
In rouble terms the coupon amounts to 149,788 roubles. Coupon accruals equal 92,177.23 roubles.
The issue yielded 90.02 percent at Tuesday's close.

On November 6 the finance ministry will also pay about 1.09 trillion roubles in interest on the two-year bond maturing in February 1998 (series 24006) and repay about 5.97 trillion roubles in maturing six-month T-bill (series 22032).
